caption: capcom's cel-shaded tuner - arcade drift physics wearing comic-book paint, dug for pcsx2.
about: Auto modellista (2002) is capcom's first racing game: cel-shaded art over genuine tuning depth, drift-heavy arcade physics and an online lobby that was ahead of its console's playerbase. The owner's cel-shaded note describes exactly what makes it memorable - the comic look over honest drift tuning - and the style remains the point two decades later.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
